description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc., founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products, and a steward of over 20 luxury and prestige brands globally. Since the initial launch of the Estée Lauder brand in the United States it has significantly expanded its consumer reach to approximately 150 countries and territories. It operates as a wholesaler, with products sold in brick-and-mortar locations and on various e-commerce platforms including those operated by department stores, duty-free retailers, specialty-multi retailers, online pure players, upscale perfumeries and pharmacies, and top-tier salons and spas, and additionally operates a direct-to-consumer business across freestanding stores, its brands' websites and third-party online platforms. In February 2025 it embarked on Beauty Reimagined, a strategic vision focused on accelerating best-in-class consumer coverage, creating transformative innovation and boosting consumer-facing investment.
